G: Sameclass actual pairs, preserved RGB, full text and measured depth. Pair choice A/B/N/U twice with swapped crop/label order; per-object role T/R/O/U independent calls. No random-caption scores or required reversal.
pair_selection: All independent sameclass masks; max4 main-mapped pairs plus1 mapping-failed probe per sample, fixed input hash order independent of captions/GT/source score.
primary_acceptance: Same physical requested subject in2orders; role=T for winner, R/O for loser; pair-local positive/negative 3D query sets with actual LiDAR support. No global winner required.
mapping: Minimum3 depth-trimmed exclusive points in candidate; coverage>=.15; projectionIoU>=.1; other paired mask support<=.2*own. No all-point purity or dominant component fraction requirement.
audits: Same calls, primary vs previous strict mapping vs1point/coverage-relaxed mapping; retain all pairs rejected at role/order/mapping stages. Post-seal task utility is descriptive, not physical identity GT.
A_subsets_separate: R16old32 and other_R15fresh32; both historically exposed, not confirmation test
TTA: Only final query matching projection Linear288to64,32AdamWstepslr1e-4, text/head boxes/backbone/decoder frozen
direct_no_update: Same A preferences and frozen B features, preference kernel direct rerank. B RGB/G absent from both fitting and control.
scope: Finite real-data discrimination, no source retraining
